description: This file defines the Layout class within the OpenCart administration model for design layout management. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving layout records, as well as managing associated routes and modules in the database.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Represents the layout management in the admin design module, including CRUD operations for layout records, routes, and modules.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Creates a new layout record in the database, including optional routes and modules.

methods.name: editLayout
methods.description: Updates an existing layout record, replacing its routes and modules.

methods.name: deleteLayout
methods.description: Deletes a layout and all associated routes, modules, and related entity references.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves a specific layout record by its ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of layouts with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLayouts
methods.description: Returns the total count of layout records.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a route associated with a layout.

methods.name: deleteRoutes
methods.description: Deletes all routes for a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteRoutesByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes layout routes based on layout ID.

methods.name: deleteRoutesByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes layout routes associated with a specific store.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Retrieves all routes for a layout.

methods.name: getRoutesByStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves all routes associated with a given store.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a module to a layout.

methods.name: deleteModules
methods.description: Deletes all modules associated with a layout.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes modules based on their code, including variants.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves all modules associated with a layout.

search-terms: management of layout routes and modules
